dims.flowdec: S = F * upp; A = (F - flow_margin - dec_margin) * upp
dims.knn: T = 20 ms content frames; N >= min_index_rows

phase.value: phase[j] = frac(phase0 + sum(wrap(upp * f0 / sr)) over the earlier frames), per window frame, computed in f64; wrap(x) = fmod(x + 0.5, 1) - 0.5 (the same carry as the HiFi-GAN templates' phase0, at every window frame)
